defs.def: to place sth over or in front of sth in order to hide or protect it 掩蔽；遮盖

ex.s: And are listening to and viewing content as effective as reading the written word when covering the same material?
ex.t: 在学习同样的材料时，听和看内容与阅读文字一样有效吗？

ex.s: The 2.5-hour tour covers the Gooyer Windmill, the Skinny Bridge, the Rijksmuseum, Heineken Brewery and much more.
ex.t: 2.5小时的游览涵盖古伊风车、瘦桥、国立博物馆、喜力啤酒厂等地。

ex.s: Reaching as far as the eye can see, these terraces cover tall mountains, often from the bottom to the very top.

ex.s: His books cover a lot of subjects, including philosophy, logic, politics and natural science.
ex.t: 他的书涵盖了很多主题，包括哲学、逻辑学、政治学和自然科学。

defs.def: to lie or spread over the surface of sth 盖；覆盖
to put or spread a layer of liquid, dust, etc. on sb/sth 撒上，洒上，溅上（一层液体、尘土等）
to include sth; to deal with sth 包括；包含；涉及；处理
to be or provide enough money for sth 足以支付；够付

ex.s: I don't trust my laptop's spellchecker. ____37____ Of course, these days there are plenty of online dictionaries and thesauruses, but I'm old-fashioned enough to prefer a hard cover and pages I can leaf through with my fingers.
ex.t: 我不信任笔记本电脑的拼写检查。____37____ 当然，如今有很多在线词典和同义词词典，但我足够老派，更喜欢硬壳书和可用手指翻阅的书页。

ex.s: C．Provide a cover for the essay．
ex.t: C．为论文提供一个封面。

defs.def: to travel the distance mentioned 行走（一段路程）

ex.s: However, most produce at the store went through weeks of travel and covered hundreds of miles before reaching the table.
ex.t: 然而，商店里的大多数农产品在端上餐桌之前都经过了数周的运输、跨越了数百英里。

defs.def: to spread over the area mentioned 占（一片面积）

ex.s: The Chinese government recently finalized a plan to set up a Giant Panda National Park(GPNP). ___56___ (cover)an area about three times ___57___ size of Yellowstone National Park, the GPNP will be one of the first national parks in the country.
ex.t: 中国政府最近敲定了一项建立大熊猫国家公园（GPNP）的计划。（第56空，cover）约（第57空）黄石国家公园三倍的面积，GPNP将成为该国首批国家公园之一。

ex.s: They cover a vast area.
ex.t: 它们覆盖着广袤的区域。

ex.s: Background information Yellowstone National Park was set up in 1872.It covers an area of about 9,000 square kilometres, and there are lakes, canyons, rivers and mountains.
ex.t: 背景信息：黄石国家公园于1872年建立，占地面积约9000平方公里，有湖泊、峡谷、河流和山脉。

defs.def: to report on an event for television, a newspaper, etc; to show an event on television 报道；电视报道

ex.s: •Do not cover or block your smoke detector in any way．
ex.t: •不要以任何方式遮盖或堵塞你的烟雾探测器。

defs.def: to do sb's work or duties while they are away 代替，顶替，替补（某人工作或履行职责）
to invent a lie or an excuse that will stop sb from getting into trouble （为免他人陷入麻烦而用谎话或借口）遮掩，掩盖，敷衍
to protect sb against loss, injury, etc. by insurance 给 … 保险
to take action in order to protect yourself against being blamed for sth 采取行动（以使自己免遭责备）

ex.s: Jennifer received great support from her family as she worked to earn her degree: Her husband worked two jobs to cover the bills, and her 68-year-old mother helped take care of the children at times.
ex.t: 珍妮弗在努力攻读学位的过程中得到了家人的大力支持：她的丈夫打两份工来支付账单她68岁的母亲有时帮忙照看孩子。

defs.def: to protect sb by threatening to shoot at anyone who tries to attack them 掩护

ex.s: More recently, as books have become inexpensive or even throwaway, artists have used them as the raw material for artworks — transforming covers, pages or even complete volumes into paintings and sculptures.
ex.t: 更近一些时候，随着书籍变得廉价甚至可以随意丢弃，艺术家们开始把它们用作艺术品的原材料——把封面、书页甚至整册书变成绘画和雕塑。

defs.def: to aim a gun at a place or person so that nobody can escape or shoot 用枪瞄准（以致无人可逃跑或开枪）
to record a new version of a song that was originally recorded by another band or singer 翻唱（原来由另一乐队或歌手演唱的歌曲）
to cover sth completely so that it cannot be seen （完全）盖住，遮住
to try to stop people from knowing the truth about a mistake, a crime, etc. 掩盖（错误、罪行等的）真相

ex.s: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry, “food waste goes against the moral grain,” as Elizabeth Royte writes in this month’s cover story.
ex.t: 在一个每年近8亿人挨饿的世界里，"食物浪费违背道德准则，"伊丽莎白·罗伊特在本月封面故事中写道。

defs.def: a thing that is put over or on another thing, usually to protect it or to decorate it 覆盖物；掩蔽物；套子；罩子
a place that provides shelter from bad weather or protection from an attack 躲避处；避难所；庇护所
the outside of a book or a magazine （书刊的）封面，封皮

ex.s: To serve its function, a book must be activated by a user: the cover opened, the pages parted, the contents reviewed, perhaps notes written down or words underlined.
ex.t: 要发挥其功能，书必须由使用者来"激活"：打开封面，翻动书页，浏览内容，也许写下笔记或划出重点。

defs.def: protection that an insurance company provides by promising to pay you money if a particular event happens （保险公司的）保险
support and protection that is provided when sb is attacking or in danger of being attacked 掩护；防护
trees and plants that grow on an area of land （生长在一个地区的）树木植物，自然植被
the fact of the sky being covered with cloud or the ground with snow （云层的）遮盖；（雪的）覆盖

ex.s: I removed the sticky spider-webs that covered her head and wings.
ex.t: 我清除覆盖在她头部和翅膀上的粘性蜘蛛网。

ex.t: 缩小到在线测试中尚未涵盖的内容

ex.s: During autumn, these same mountains are gold, and in winter they are covered in sheets white frost.

ex.s: Further up, the weather   55   — low clouds envelope the mountainsides, which are covered with thick grass.

defs.def: the sheets, blankets, etc. on a bed 床单；床罩；毯子；被子
activities or behaviour that seem honest or true but that hide sb's real identity or feelings, or that hide sth illegal （对身分、感情或违法事情的）掩盖，掩饰
the fact of sb doing another person's job when they are away or when there are not enough staff 代替工作；代劳；替补
